text:
Sam H: Quickstart stuck for a new sign-up — first call returns a 403 with a billing error. Anyone seen this workflow before?
Alex R: Which quickstart are you using? Node or curl?
Sam H: curl, following docs example. workspace is `acme-dev` and I used the provided API key from the console.
Sam H: Here’s the curl output:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_dev_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-3","input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"billing.required","message":"Workspace billing not enabled: contact billing to enable API access"}
```
Priya K: That error means the workspace hasn’t been transitioned off trial or the billing status flag is unset. Did the user finish the workspace setup flow?
Sam H: I finished the onboarding forms in the console and clicked "Enable API" — it looked like it succeeded (green toast) but requests still 403.
Maya L: Can you paste the workspace id from the console? Also is the key scoped to that workspace or to your user org?
Sam H: Workspace id: ws_acme_42. Key is the one shown under "API keys" for that workspace.
Alex R: @billing-bot do we have any recent gated events for ws_acme_42?
billing-bot: Billing check for ws_acme_42: status=trial_expired, api_access=false, last_invoice=2026-02-28. Suggest contacting billing team to flip api_access.
Chris T: I can flip the flag, but curious why the UI showed success. Might be async job. @infra-bot can you check the jobs queue for the billing toggle?
infra-bot: Found async job 84211 for ws_acme_42: started 1763008860, worker-retry=3, final state=failed, error="rate-limit on backend billing API".
Priya K: Ok that explains it — UI optimistic success but backend rollback. Two ways to unblock: manually flip api_access on billing side (fast) OR requeue the async job after rate limit resets.
Sam H: @Chris T if you can flip that flag that’s easiest for me. Thanks.
Chris T: Done — set api_access=true for ws_acme_42 and forced job retry. Confirmed in billing system.
billing-bot: Billing check for ws_acme_42: status=active, api_access=true.
Sam H: Re-ran the same curl — now 200 and got streaming tokens. First successful call!!! :tada:
Sam H: Quick notes for docs: the console should show a clearer state when backend async job fails (not just a green toast). Also maybe retry logic for the onboarding toggle.
Maya L: Agreed. Filing a small devex ticket to add an explicit "activation pending" state and retry hints.
Alex R: Thanks all — good catch on the worker retry. Sam, can you drop the exact console screenshot in the ticket?
Sam H: Will do. And adding a note to the onboarding quickstart about potential billing gating and who to ping.
Priya K: Also adding a small log line trace id to the UI toast so support can correlate.
Chris T: Follow-ups: (1) add retry/backoff for the billing API job, (2) ensure UI reflects async failure, (3) devex doc update.
Sam H: Awesome — passing along to the new user. Appreciate the fast help! :rocket:
